title: Central Government Must Make Rules For Qualifications, Appointment, Term Of Office, Salaries And Allowances, Resignation

content.scenario: The Central Government is planning to make rules for the qualifications, appointment, term of office, salaries and allowances, resignation, removal and other terms and conditions of service of the President and members of the National Commission. The Central Government must make these rules to ensure that the President and members of the National Commission are eligible for re-appointment and that their term of office does not exceed five years.
content.outcome: The Central Government must make rules for the qualifications, appointment, term of office, salaries and allowances, resignation, removal and other terms and conditions of service of the President and members of the National Commission.
